company.description:
Lamsa Kids World is a state of the art digital service tailored for children availing a world of creativity and imagination!

Delivering entertainment and fun, along with allowing for an interactive, perceptive, and exciting learning experience, Lamsa offers value to:

Toddlers (ages 1-3 years)
Preschoolers (ages 4-6 years)
School-aged children (ages 6-8 years)


This value is delivered via a wide array of content varying in context and type and includes interactive stories, games, art, rhymes, and learning.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,779,765 to $33,054,538, a 6.92x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 49 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 12 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
